recentItems.description:
Actor Dhanush's distribution of silver Kamatchi lamps engraved with a lotus motif to 3,000 women functionaries in Chennai has ignited intense political controversy in Tamil Nadu. The Congress alleged a covert BJP 'Operation D' plot, while the ruling TVK led by CM Vijay dismissed Dhanush's electoral clout.
